_comment: Source of truth for WP page structure + primary nav menu. Applied via `wp usctdp import_pages data/pages.json`. Only covers pages that back a real wp_posts row (post_type=page) via a Blade 'Template Name' template. Routes with no WP page (e.g. /programming/juniors/, /our-team/{slug}/ — see resources/views/routes/web.php) are NOT listed here; link to them from the menu with a 'url' entry instead. Menu items take exactly one of: 'page' (slug from the pages array above), 'url' (a site-relative path, prefixed with home_url()), or 'external' (a full off-site URL, used as-is). 'permalink_structure' is optional; when set, it's applied via WP's rewrite API (same as Settings -> Permalinks) so pages resolve to clean URLs instead of ?page_id=N. 'woocommerce' is optional; its keys map to WooCommerce -> Settings -> Products toggles, plus 'classic_cart'/'classic_checkout' which overwrite the auto-created Cart/Checkout pages' content with the [woocommerce_cart]/[woocommerce_checkout] shortcodes in place of the block editor markup. 'forms' is optional; each entry is matched to an existing Contact Form 7 form by 'title' (created if missing) and its 'form'/'mail'/'messages' keys are written directly onto CF7's own property structure (WPCF7_ContactForm::get_properties()), same as saving the form in wp-admin -> Contact -> Contact Forms. Requires the contact-form-7 plugin (wpackagist-plugin/contact-form-7 in composer.json) to be active; the import warns and skips forms otherwise.

forms.title: Contact Page Form
forms.form:
[text* your-name id:contact-name autocomplete:name class:contact-input placeholder "Your full name"]
[email* your-email id:contact-email autocomplete:email class:contact-input placeholder "you@example.com"]
[text your-subject id:contact-subject autocomplete:off class:contact-input placeholder "What's this about?"]
[textarea* your-message id:contact-message class:contact-input class:resize-y placeholder "How can we help you?"]
[submit class:contact-submit "Send Message"]

mail.subject: New contact form message: [your-subject]
mail.body:
From: [your-name] <[your-email]>
Subject: [your-subject]

Message Body:
[your-message]

--
This email was sent from the contact form on usctdp.com (IP address: [_remote_ip])

messages.mail_sent_ok: Thank you for reaching out! We'll get back to you as soon as possible.
messages.mail_sent_ng: Something went wrong. Please try again or email us directly at tennis@usctdp.com.
